title: Weapon Set Passive Points Explained
summary: What Weapon Set Passive Points are in Path of Exile 2, where every Book of Specialization drops, how to allocate them to Weapon Set I or II, and the hybrid builds they enable.
description: A complete explainer for Weapon Set Passive Points in Path of Exile 2: how to get Books of Specialization and how to spend the points per weapon set.
prerequisites: A character that has reached the Hunting Grounds (Act 1)
Two weapon sets equipped in your inventory
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: What are they?
body: Weapon Set Passive Points are not extra points. A Book of Specialization lets you take points you already earned and dedicate them to Weapon Set I or Weapon Set II, so they only activate while that weapon set is equipped.

items.title: How do I get them?
body: From Books of Specialization dropped by optional bosses (Crowbell, Kabala, Mighty Silverfist) or granted by side quests (Tradition's Toll), plus the Sacrificial Heart ritual in Act 3. Each source gives 2 points.

items.title: Why bother?
body: They let one character run two real builds - for example a melee set and a ranged set, or a fire set and a lightning set - without overloading a single passive path.

sections.title: How to allocate
sections.intro: Allocating Weapon Set Points is done entirely in the Passive Skill Tree. Follow the tab for each step.

tabs.label: Open the tree
paragraphs: Open the Passive Skill Tree and look at the top-right corner.
bullets: You will see two boxes: 'I Weapon Set' and 'II Weapon Set' with a spent / available count.
If neither set is selected, a normal point applies to BOTH sets.
Weapon Set Points only appear after you use a Book of Specialization.

tabs.label: Assign to a set
paragraphs: Hold the allocate button on a node to choose which set it feeds.
bullets: Pick Weapon Set I or II; the node path changes colour to show the allocation.
Only Weapon Set Points can extend a red/green branch - normal points cannot continue it.
Swap weapons (press X by default) to watch the tree reroute live.

tabs.label: Refund
paragraphs: Refunding works like normal points but costs gold.
bullets: Use The Hooded One (town) or Doryani (hideout after Act 3).
Attribute nodes refund at a 50% discount, encouraging early experimentation.
Plan the path so Weapon Set Points connect to key notables for each weapon.

sections.title: Builds that benefit most
sections.intro: Weapon Set Points shine for hybrid play. A few examples:

cards.title: Melee + Ranged
body: Weapon Set I spec into melee defenses; Weapon Set II spec into projectile damage. Swap based on the fight.

cards.title: Fire + Lightning
body: A Sorceress can allocate fire nodes to one set and lightning nodes to the other, switching elements without respeccing.

cards.title: Weapon Master node
body: Some Ascendancies (e.g. the Weapon Master node) convert 20 passive points into Weapon Set Points, greatly expanding customization.

sections.title: Why are my points not applying?
sections.intro: Select the problem you see. The tool gives the fix.

rules.title: Use a Book of Specialization first
steps: Weapon Set Points only appear after consuming a Book of Specialization (or a Sacrificial Heart ritual).
Kill The Crowbell in Hunting Grounds for the first book, or do Tradition's Toll in Act 2.
Check the top-right of the Passive Tree for the I / II counters.

rules.title: They are set-specific by design
steps: Points allocated to Weapon Set I only show while Set I is equipped - this is intended.
Press X to swap sets and watch the tree reroute; the other set's nodes light up.
If you want a point always on, allocate it with neither set selected.

rules.title: Use Weapon Set Points, not normal points
steps: Only Weapon Set Points can extend the red/green set-specific branches.
Normal leveling points cannot continue that path - you need more Books of Specialization.
Plan a long shared trunk so both sets branch off it efficiently.

rules.title: Refund from The Hooded One or Doryani
steps: Refund at The Hooded One in town, or Doryani in your hideout after Act 3.
Attribute nodes refund at a 50% discount.
Reallocate to the set and nodes you actually use.

defaultResult.title: General allocation plan
steps: Collect Books of Specialization from optional bosses and side quests.
Open the Passive Tree, pick Set I or II, and extend a shared trunk with set-specific branches.
Swap weapons to confirm the tree reroutes before committing.

items.question: Are Weapon Set Points extra skill points?
answer: No. A Book of Specialization takes points you already earned and dedicates them to a weapon set. They only activate for that set.

items.question: Can I get them from vendors with currency?
answer: No. Books of Specialization come only from optional bosses, specific side quests, and the Sacrificial Heart ritual. They are not bought with currency.

items.question: Do they carry into Cruel?
answer: Yes. Cruel repeats most campaign sources, granting a second set of Weapon Set Points for the same character.
